link_notes: Paper full text not available and README/docs are thin; labels rest on the abstract only.

open_release.rationale: Output comes from models, not real records, but no sharing or release framing appears.

pipeline_testing.rationale: Abstract says the software was thoroughly tested, which concerns msprime itself, not use of its output to test pipelines.

quotes.text: These high-performance features have been thoroughly tested and validated, and built using a collaborative, open source development model

statistical_replication.rationale: Simulations follow stated models rather than replicating a real dataset.

causal_inference.rationale: Data are simulated from specified ancestral and mutation mechanisms, which counts as known-mechanism simulation.

quotes.text: Stochastic simulation is a key tool in population genetics, since the models involved are often analytically intractable

education.rationale: Docs digest is only a redirect page, so teaching use cannot be judged.

benchmarking.rationale: Abstract says simulation is used to obtain ground-truth data to evaluate inferences.

quotes.text: simulation is usually the only way of obtaining ground-truth data to evaluate inferences.
